name: Booking
description: Booking links: availability, meeting types, team links and the public booking page

page.title: Booking
page.description: Public links for your clients to book meetings in the free times of your calendar.

errors.generic: Could not save. Please try again.

validation.intervalOrder: The end must be after the start.

availability.forbidden: You are not allowed to see this user's availability.
availability.notConfiguredHint: These are the default values. Save to start receiving bookings.
availability.weeklyHoursHint: Set the intervals in which you accept meetings. Days without intervals are unavailable.
availability.minNoticeHint: Minimum time between booking and the start of the meeting.
availability.horizonHint: How many days ahead people can book.
availability.bufferHint: Free time reserved around each meeting.

sections.hoursHint: The time zone and the intervals when you accept meetings.
sections.rulesHint: Minimum notice, daily limit, buffers between meetings and how far ahead guests can book.

meetingTypes.description: Each meeting type has its own public link.
meetingTypes.emptyDescription: Create a meeting type to get a booking link.
meetingTypes.removeDescription: The link of "{{name}}" will stop working. Existing bookings are kept.

form.description: Configure how the meeting appears on the public booking page.
form.name: Name
form.slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens. Changing it breaks the old link.
form.locationValueHint: Shown to the guest only after booking.
form.teamHint: Pick a distribution rule so the booking is assigned to a team member.
form.questionsHint: Extra questions for the guest (up to 10). Answers can fill contact fields.
